```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  dco-check:
    if: github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify DCO sign-off
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "Checking DCO sign-off for all commits in the PR..."
          missing=()
          commits=$(git log --no-merges --pretty=format:%H ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}..${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }})
          if [ -z "$commits" ]; then
            echo "No commits found in the PR."
            exit 0
          fi
          while read -r commit; do
            body=$(git show -s --format=%B "$commit")
            if ! echo "$body" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              missing+=("$commit")
            fi
          done <<< "$commits"
          if [ ${#missing[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ The following commits are missing DCO sign-off:"
            for c in "${missing[@]}"; do
              echo "- $c"
            done
            echo
            echo "Please add a Signed-off-by line to each commit. You can do this by amending the commits:"
            echo "  git commit --amend -s"
            echo "or by rebase with signoff:"
            echo "  git rebase -i --signoff"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All commits have DCO sign-off."
          fi
```
